subject: jumping spider
title: This Spider Nurses Her Babies on Milk With 4x the Protein of a Cow's

scenes.text: These baby spiders never hunt. They still grow fast.
Scientists in China watched an ant-like jumping spider and saw why.
The mother leaks droplets from her belly. The babies drink them. Later they suck straight from her body.
It's a kind of milk, with about four times the protein of cow's milk.
For twenty days it's all they eat. When researchers blocked it, every baby died within about ten days.
She keeps nursing for about forty days, even after they can hunt. A spider, mothering like a mammal.

description:
The jumping spider Toxeus magnus, which looks like an ant, feeds its young a milk-like fluid from the underside of its abdomen.
For the first 20 days the spiderlings eat nothing else; when researchers sealed the opening, all of them died within about 10 days. The fluid has nearly four times the protein of cow's milk, and the mother goes on nursing until about day 40, after her young have started hunting. The study, from the Chinese Academy of Sciences, was published in Science in 2018.
Does this change what you think of spiders? Comment below.
first_comment: With the milk, 76 percent of the spiderlings survived to adulthood. Which animal do you think is the best mother?
